english.title: Control order now expired fail to report to specified person on re-entry to UK
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having left the United Kingdom on a date when

(A)_[a derogating control order made by **(..SPECIFY THE COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..)]_
(B)_[a non-derogating control order made by the Secretary of State on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE..)]_

was in existence, which required you to report to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) on your return to the United Kingdom you failed to report to that person in the manner that was required by that order
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(2) and (4) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005.

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording document was REPEALED by section 1of the Terrorism Prevention and Investigation Measures Act 2011 as from 14/12/2011

(i) This offence wording should be used where the control order has ceased to be in existence.
(ii) If a person re-enters the UK whilst the control order is still in existence and fails to report to a specified person then he commits an offence under Section 9(1) of the Act. See H6034 and CJS Code PT05001

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

NOTE: 6 months imprisonment prior to s154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 coming into force)

INDICTMENT: 5 years imprisonment and /or a fine.

Time limit on Prosecutions:
None
